lines.text: Before you donate your dad's 1990s camera, look at what happened to mine.
It was sitting in a donate box, between a broken lamp and some old cables.
Every summer, he'd point it at me. And I'd hide my face.
Click. Whirr. Click. Thirty-six shots a roll, and he made every one count.
Turns out, film is back. Some cameras from the nineties now sell for more than they cost new.
So before the box went out, I scanned it.
An estimated two hundred to four hundred dollars.
I didn't sell it. I bought a roll of film.
I used Scan For Worth. Check the box before it goes.
